The '''Second Outer Rim Fleet''' was a military formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Fel Empire]]. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Ephin Sarreti (Star Destroyer)|''Ephin Sarreti'']], where [[Rulf Yage]] served, was part of the fleet.
